budget_match.description: Calculates compatibility by comparing plan premium against customer target budget limit.

coverage_match.description: Measures suitability of coverage limits for family floater sizing requirements.

eligibility_match.description: Checks age, income limits, and budget floors for binary pre-qualification.

risk_match.description: Matches plan rider holdings to the calculated client underwriting risk tier.

claim_support_match.description: Grants high score based on Aegis' high 98.4% claim ratio and network hospitals list.

preference_match.description: Evaluates client keyword overlap (e.g. cashless, zero-copay, engine-protect) with plan options.
